recommendations.issue: Inconsistent food quality due to preparation, sourcing, and inadequate quality control.
recommendations.action: Implement a comprehensive kitchen quality control program. This includes daily taste tests by the head chef, mandatory adherence to standardized recipes, and a review of all primary ingredient suppliers for quality and consistency. Conduct immediate retraining for all kitchen staff on core menu item preparation and plating standards.
recommendations.expected_impact: Significant improvement in food consistency and overall customer satisfaction, directly addressing the most frequent complaint.

recommendations.issue: General negative customer experiences stemming from undefined processes and minor operational inefficiencies.
recommendations.action: Develop and implement a 'Customer Issue Resolution Protocol' for front-of-house staff, empowering them with clear guidelines and limited authority to address common complaints on the spot. Additionally, conduct a weekly 15-minute operational huddle with all department heads (kitchen, FOH, bar) to identify and resolve minor cross-departmental inefficiencies.
recommendations.expected_impact: Reduction in general negative feedback, improved staff confidence in handling issues, and a smoother overall customer experience.
